# Hyperparameter Optimizer

> Black-box hyperparameter optimization built from scratch: random and quasi-random search, a Tree-structured Parzen Estimator, and Gaussian-process Bayesian optimization with Expected Improvement.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/hyperparameter-optimizer

## Source

- [src/hyperparameter_optimizer/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hyperparameter-optimizer/blob/main/src/hyperparameter_optimizer/__init__.py): Hyperparameter Optimizer - black-box optimization samplers and surrogates from scratch.
- [src/hyperparameter_optimizer/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hyperparameter-optimizer/blob/main/src/hyperparameter_optimizer/cli.py): Command line interface for the hyperparameter optimizer.
- [src/hyperparameter_optimizer/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hyperparameter-optimizer/blob/main/src/hyperparameter_optimizer/evaluation.py): Evaluate sampler sample-efficiency across the benchmark objectives.
- [src/hyperparameter_optimizer/linalg.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hyperparameter-optimizer/blob/main/src/hyperparameter_optimizer/linalg.py): A tiny, from-scratch linear-algebra kernel for the Gaussian process.
- [src/hyperparameter_optimizer/objectives.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hyperparameter-optimizer/blob/main/src/hyperparameter_optimizer/objectives.py): Standard black-box objective functions used to benchmark samplers.
- [src/hyperparameter_optimizer/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hyperparameter-optimizer/blob/main/src/hyperparameter_optimizer/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service.
- [src/hyperparameter_optimizer/samplers/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hyperparameter-optimizer/blob/main/src/hyperparameter_optimizer/samplers/__init__.py): Samplers propose the next unit-cube point to evaluate.
- [src/hyperparameter_optimizer/samplers/base.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hyperparameter-optimizer/blob/main/src/hyperparameter_optimizer/samplers/base.py): The sampler protocol: propose a unit point given the trials seen so far.
- [src/hyperparameter_optimizer/samplers/gp.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hyperparameter-optimizer/blob/main/src/hyperparameter_optimizer/samplers/gp.py): Gaussian-Process Bayesian optimization with Expected Improvement.
- [src/hyperparameter_optimizer/samplers/random.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hyperparameter-optimizer/blob/main/src/hyperparameter_optimizer/samplers/random.py): Random and quasi-random (Sobol) samplers.
- [src/hyperparameter_optimizer/samplers/tpe.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hyperparameter-optimizer/blob/main/src/hyperparameter_optimizer/samplers/tpe.py): The Tree-structured Parzen Estimator (TPE).
- [src/hyperparameter_optimizer/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hyperparameter-optimizer/blob/main/src/hyperparameter_optimizer/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the optimizer.
- [src/hyperparameter_optimizer/space.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hyperparameter-optimizer/blob/main/src/hyperparameter_optimizer/space.py): Search-space primitives: the parameters an optimizer proposes values for.
- [src/hyperparameter_optimizer/study.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hyperparameter-optimizer/blob/main/src/hyperparameter_optimizer/study.py): The Study: the optimization loop and its ask/tell interface.
- [src/hyperparameter_optimizer/trial.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/hyperparameter-optimizer/blob/main/src/hyperparameter_optimizer/trial.py): Trials: a proposed configuration and, once evaluated, its objective value.
